'''Rockshell''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Turtuff]] at 6 silver stars, and into [[Terraton]] at 6 silver moons after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "That thick rocky shell of Rockshell is a reliable source of comfort. When Zobos come attacking, there's no need to panic. Just standing there is enough to tank whatever comes."

Rockshell is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A yellowish-tan tortoise with a white chin, brown eyebrows, and a rocky brown shell that's larger than its body. Its eyes are yellow.

Rockshell's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces tan with orange, white with light yellow, and brown becomes turquoise green. Its eyes also become turquoise green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Rockshell's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 silver moons/91 copies. To evolve it into [[Terraton]], you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 120 treasure) or [[Events|Cozy Farm]] (use x7200 fertilizer).
* Own 5 Rock [[Badge Dojo|Badges]].

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "The Rockshell's stones are just for decoration, but the [[Zobos]] don't care and don't understand."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Rarely speaks up so it's difficult for other Tatari to guess what Rockshell's thinking. Yet Rockshell is always the first to step up when help is needed. "
